boundary: Re-measured by dispatching one real native Run per installed runtime through runtime.run.dispatch inside a disposable canary, so the rows marked dispatched_run rest on what a child process emitted rather than on what a CLI advertises. Rows marked driver_seam rest on the eawf driver call being exercised, and rows marked runtime_surface rest on a separate zero-token subprocess of the installed CLI, which is weaker than a driven turn: two codex rows sit there because the one-shot codex stream announces no tool, skill or agent inventory the way the claude stream does. opencode was absent from PATH, so its eight rows are UNKNOWN rather than passing. The codex child cannot start under the eawf seatbelt jail with its own sandbox on, so this probe supplied a sandbox flag the shipped launcher does not pass. The claude child inherited the operator's own hooks, plugins and MCP servers, so its announced inventory describes this workstation rather than a clean install. One workstation, one account tier, one turn per runtime.
